summary: Tested the home visit tracking fix. The backend endpoint works: a new visitor_id gives ok:true and the total goes up by 1, the same visitor_id right after gives skipped:duplicate, and the admin endpoints need auth. In a real browser the fix DOES NOT WORK: opening /inicio.html in a fresh browser sends no request to /api/track/access and adds no entry. Root cause: inicio.html has a leftover SingleFile <meta http-equiv=content-security-policy> with default-src 'none' and no connect-src, so Chrome blocks the fetch (console: 'Connecting to .../api/track/access violates the following Content Security Policy directive: default-src none'). keepalive and the localStorage fallback are fine but do not matter while CSP blocks the call. When we ran Playwright with bypass_csp=True, home followed by a fast click to /edital-25.html recorded /inicio.html correctly, which confirms CSP is the only blocker. Opening /edital-25.html, /edital-24.html or /dados-inscricao.html directly added no entries, but only because the same CSP blocks the tracking script that edital-24/25 still contain. /termos-concurso.html has no CSP meta and DOES add an access entry, which breaks the 'only the home tracks' rule.

integration_issues.issue: The CSP meta tag (default-src 'none', no connect-src) blocks fetch('/api/track/access'). 0 track requests were sent and 0 entries added in a fresh Chromium context. Fast navigation to edital-25 also records nothing.

/termos-concurso.html still runs the tracking script (no CSP there), so every direct visit adds an access entry with page /termos-concurso.html. edital-24.html and edital-25.html also still contain the tracking script. It is only blocked by their CSP meta and would start counting if that CSP is removed or relaxed globally.

action_items: In /app/frontend/public/inicio.html add connect-src 'self' to the CSP meta, or remove the meta entirely. Example: "default-src 'none'; connect-src 'self'; ...". Then check in a fresh browser that POST /api/track/access is sent.
Remove the /api/track/access script from termos-concurso.html, edital-24.html and edital-25.html, so only the home tracks no matter what CSP is set.
Optional: use navigator.sendBeacon (Blob, application/json) as a fallback to fetch keepalive. It is also governed by connect-src.
critical_code_review_comments: The fix only changed the JS (keepalive / localStorage try-catch) and never checked that the request actually leaves the browser. The SingleFile-saved page has a CSP that forbids all network connections.
The 'intermittent' symptom is probably a mix of two things: home never counts in CSP-enforcing browsers, while termos-concurso.html counts (and dedupes the visitor for 30 minutes).

success_rate.frontend: 25% - home tracking 0/2 flows pass; only-home rule fails for termos-concurso

Also check that termos-concurso/edital pages add no entries.
rca of the issue: Repro: open /inicio.html in fresh Chromium. The console shows a CSP violation for /api/track/access and no network request is made. Cause: <meta http-equiv='content-security-policy' content="default-src 'none'; ... script-src 'unsafe-inline' data:; ..."> with no connect-src. Confirmed: with bypass_csp=True the home visit is recorded even with an immediate click to /edital-25.html. Mitigation: add connect-src 'self' to the inicio.html CSP and remove the tracking scripts from the non-home pages.
